summary: `ringChooseSpan` is public but unexposed and ships with no `_def` restatement and no induction principle, so downstream modules cannot eliminate membership except through `ringChooseSpan_le_iff` — the file's own proof needs `rw [ringChooseSpan]` to get at `AddSubgroup.closure_induction₂`, which is unavailable outside this module. The Kostant application is also stated only at the `toAddSubgroup` level, omitting the subring-level containment the file's main theorem exists to justify.
